releaseNotes:
• Structured pulseforce/ Storage Tree: Organizes all user data into Documents/pulseforce/ (profile, daily_readings, nutrition, workouts, telemetry, sleep_lifestyle).
• Multi-Day Recordings History: Automatically records and preserves dated daily snapshots & multi_day_history.json across multiple days.
• Continue with Google Sign-In: Added native Android Google account picker + fallback email flow on the Welcome/Login screen.
